notice: SYNTHETIC mapping for the invented Stage 37 fixture only (generate_master_fixture.py, v1). The constructs, items, coping groups and hypotheses below are fictional labels for testing the program; they are not the UCLA, SACS, WHO-5 or MSPSS instruments, use no validated scoring keys and produce no empirical finding.

avoidance_like.generator_relation: each group's latent factor is N(0, 0.9) + 0.15 * x: a positive relation with the latent X

assertive_like.generator_relation: each group's latent factor is N(0, 0.9) - 0.15 * x: a negative relation with the latent X

covariates.sex_code: nominal 0/1/2: dummy codes against category 0 (the linear model codes it itself; the path models use the derived 0/1 columns SYN_SEX_1 and SYN_SEX_2)

missing_data.policy: listwise deletion in every analysis; a prorated re-scoring (mean of the answered items of a scale) is the sensitivity comparison

prorated_columns.SYN_COPE_DIM1_PRORATED: mean of the answered items SYN_COPE_01..07
prorated_columns.SYN_SUP_PRORATED: mean of the answered items SYN_SUP_01..12

H1.question: predict
H1.text: [SYNTHETIC] The X-like score is associated with the Y-like score, alone and with age, sex and employment in the model.
analyses: linear_model: Y ~ X + age + C(sex) + C(employed)

H2.question: relate
H2.text: [SYNTHETIC] The X-like score is associated with the avoidance-like and the assertive-like coping dimensions.

H3.question: relate
H3.text: [SYNTHETIC] The coping dimensions are associated with the Y-like score.
analyses: batch_correlation (Pearson, Holm): Y with M-like, avoidance-like, assertive-like

H4.question: process
H4.text: [SYNTHETIC] X is associated with Y through the M-like and the avoidance-like coping dimensions (parallel indirect paths), with age, sex and employment as covariates.
analyses: mediation: PROCESS-equivalent Model 4, percentile bootstrap, B = 5000, fixed seed

H5.question: process
H5.text: [SYNTHETIC] The association of X with Y depends on W.
analyses: moderation: PROCESS-equivalent Model 1, X x W -> Y, simple slopes, Johnson-Neyman

H6.question: process
H6.text: [SYNTHETIC] The association of X with the avoidance-like dimension depends on W.
analyses: moderation: PROCESS-equivalent Model 1, X x W -> avoidance-like

H7.question: process
H7.text: [SYNTHETIC] Exploratory: W moderates the X -> M path (first stage).

H8.question: process
H8.text: [SYNTHETIC] Exploratory: W moderates the M -> Y path (second stage).

model_7_vs_14: Model 7 and Model 14 are separate, explicitly specified analyses: in Model 7 W multiplies X in the M equation (index a3*b), in Model 14 W multiplies M in the Y equation (index a*b3). The X x W -> avoidance-like hypothesis (H6) is a moderation of another outcome and is neither of them.
